title: Texas Voluntary Cleanup Program: what the certificate of completion does
rule: Any Texas site, except a part under a commission permit or order, may enter TCEQ's Voluntary Cleanup Program: the applicant files an application with a $1,000 fee, signs a cleanup agreement and pays TCEQ's oversight costs. A completed cleanup earns a certificate of completion. Persons who are not responsible parties are released from liability to the state for cleanup of the covered areas, except releases they cause; fraud or a change to a riskier land use defeats the release.
changeWatch: Amendments to Health and Safety Code chapter 361, subchapter S, or to TCEQ's program rules in 30 TAC chapter 333, including the application fee.
